# Spatacco Analytics

> Spatacco Analytics LLC builds and fixes the digital front office of independent financial advisors and RIAs: websites, CRM, and data. Based in Bala Cynwyd, Pennsylvania.

Spatacco Analytics was founded by a business development and M&A professional with years of experience across financial services: RIAs, PE firms, insurance companies, investment banks, broker-dealers, banks, and trust companies. It works with independent financial advisors, RIAs, and small business owners. The firm runs on Microsoft 365 Business Premium and is fluent in setting it up.

## Services

- [Website & AI Audit](https://spataccoanalytics.com/services/): a free instant website score; an Audit Report covering site, search, and AI visibility with prioritized fixes; a Practice Audit that adds a full CRM Diagnostic.
- [Website Design](https://spataccoanalytics.com/services/): refresh, redesign, or full rebuild of an advisory firm's website, built to pass compliance review.
- [CRM Diagnostic & Repair](https://spataccoanalytics.com/services/): diagnostic, repair, and rebuild or migration for any CRM that can export its data. Salesforce specialists.
- [Managed Hosting](https://spataccoanalytics.com/services/#hosting): flat monthly plans at $160, $240, and $440 per month.

Project pricing is given on request at https://spataccoanalytics.com/services/.

## How the firm works

- [How we work](https://spataccoanalytics.com/approach/): keep the way you work, lose the mess. Four steps: listen, diagnose, build, transfer.
- [About](https://spataccoanalytics.com/about/): who founded the firm and who it works with.

## Tools

- [Free Website Score](https://spataccoanalytics.com/tools/website-scorer/): scores an advisory firm's website on design, content, navigation, credibility, team, and contact.
- [Resume Parser](https://spataccoanalytics.com/tools/resume-parser/): turns a resume (PDF, Word, photos or pasted text) into structured data, downloadable as Excel or CSV. Two reads free.
- [All tools](https://spataccoanalytics.com/tools/)
